items.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
items.summary: Ukraine's president said allowing Russia to sell petroleum products would prolong a war that must be ended.
items.why_relevant: 俄柴油交易引乌批评，地缘冲突

confirmed_facts.text: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin' - Published US President Donald Trump says he has reached an agreement with Russian President Vladimir Putin allowing Moscow to "immediately release" diesel to the US and globally.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin' - Published US President Donald Trump says he has reached an agreement with Russian President Vladimir Putin allowing Moscow to "immediately release" diesel to the US and globally.

confirmed_facts.text: Trump said the proposed release of hundreds of thousands of tonnes of Russian diesel, in tranches, would see prices "COMING DOWN, IN RECORD NUMBERS, AND FAST!".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Trump said the proposed release of hundreds of thousands of tonnes of Russian diesel, in tranches, would see prices "COMING DOWN, IN RECORD NUMBERS, AND FAST!".

confirmed_facts.text: It is understood the US Treasury is suspending sanctions on Russian diesel exports until 7 April 2027 as part of the deal, but other assets like those in American banks are still frozen.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It is understood the US Treasury is suspending sanctions on Russian diesel exports until 7 April 2027 as part of the deal, but other assets like those in American banks are still frozen.

confirmed_facts.text: Ukraine's president criticised the decision, saying any easing of sanctions on Russia played into Moscow's hands and would prolong the war between the two countries.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Ukraine's president criticised the decision, saying any easing of sanctions on Russia played into Moscow's hands and would prolong the war between the two countries.

confirmed_facts.text: Trump said Putin had agreed to release 300,000 tonnes of diesel immediately, followed by 500,000 tonnes in November and another million after that.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Trump said Putin had agreed to release 300,000 tonnes of diesel immediately, followed by 500,000 tonnes in November and another million after that.

confirmed_facts.text: He added that a further three million tonnes of Russian diesel would be delivered "within a short period" after, dependent on the condition of its refineries, which have seen attacks by Ukraine.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: He added that a further three million tonnes of Russian diesel would be delivered "within a short period" after, dependent on the condition of its refineries, which have seen attacks by Ukraine.

items.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
items.summary: Several member states of the international tribunal, including the UK, say they "strongly disagree" with the sanctions.
items.why_relevant: 美国制裁ICC，国际法秩序冲击

confirmed_facts.text: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law' - Published The Trump administration has unveiled sweeping sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) in a significant acceleration of its attempt to "dismantle" what it sees as a "rogue" inst
confirmed_facts.excerpt: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law' - Published The Trump administration has unveiled sweeping sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) in a significant acceleration of its attempt to "dismantle" what it sees as a "rogue" inst

confirmed_facts.text: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the measures - which include a ban on US entities making transactions with the ICC - were intended to "defend US sovereignty" and accused the court of seeking to prosecute Americans.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the measures - which include a ban on US entities making transactions with the ICC - were intended to "defend US sovereignty" and accused the court of seeking to prosecute Americans.

confirmed_facts.text: The ICC said the measures were an assault on the rule of law and the foundations of the international legal order.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The ICC said the measures were an assault on the rule of law and the foundations of the international legal order.

confirmed_facts.text: The announcement came just hours after former ICC judge Navi Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to promote peace and international law.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The announcement came just hours after former ICC judge Navi Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to promote peace and international law.

confirmed_facts.text: However, the US has provided a six month grace period before some of these latest sanctions kick in, meaning member states can keep paying for its operations - a move Washington says is to allow countries time to negotiate a "solution to address" US concerns.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: However, the US has provided a six month grace period before some of these latest sanctions kick in, meaning member states can keep paying for its operations - a move Washington says is to allow countries time to negotiate a "solution to address" US concerns.

confirmed_facts.text: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres called the US decision "a serious blow to our collective pursuit of international criminal justice, of which the ICC is a key pillar".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres called the US decision "a serious blow to our collective pursuit of international criminal justice, of which the ICC is a key pillar".
